title: Practicum and owned-backend frontend cutover
intent: Compose feature modules through explicit Practicum/own adapters and a chat WebSocket gateway while proving both modes.

requirements.title: Two-mode frontend composition
requirements.description: Wire the feature modules to Practicum and owned API/WS adapters, register the composition root and shared message renderer, and prove mode-specific auth/chat/file flows before cutover.

constraints: Use feature ports; no backend business logic in UI.

Stage 3 guard rules and stage 3/4 feature domain contracts (auth guard/module/store/ports, chats/profile module/store) stay untouched; the only port edit is the chats user-search method that stage 4 borrowed from legacy UserApi.
Legacy src/api and MessagesController deletion is owned by this stage and happens only after replacement adapters compile.
